title: {{NAME}} and the Vanishing Fairy Garden
moral: Helping others uses the best superpower of all, your heart.

pages.content: {{NAME}} was a superhero who could run very fast. One day he flew over a glowing pink forest. A princess stood at the forest edge. She was wearing a silver dress and a blue crown. She looked very worried. "The fairy garden is disappearing!" she called out. {{NAME}} looked down. The bright flowers were fading away one by one.

pages.content: {{NAME}} landed next to the princess. The princess said her name was Sera. Sera showed {{NAME}} the fading flowers. The fairies had lost their singing voices. Without fairy songs, the garden could not grow. {{NAME}}'s eyes went wide. He looked at the tiny silent fairies. He had to think of something fast.

pages.content: {{NAME}} started to hum a happy song. He hummed loud and clear. Sera joined in and clapped. The fairies looked up. One fairy tried to hum too. Then another. Then all the fairies started to sing. Their voices filled the garden. The flowers glowed and grew tall and bright again. The garden was back!

pages.content: The head fairy flew to {{NAME}}. She was tiny and wore a crown of yellow stars. "You saved us," she said. "But how?" {{NAME}} smiled. "I just shared what I had," he said. Sera hugged {{NAME}} tight. Helping others uses the best superpower of all, your heart. The whole garden glowed brighter than ever.

pages.content: That night the fairies sang {{NAME}} and Sera a soft lullaby. The flowers swayed in time. The garden smelled of warm honey and roses. Helping others uses the best superpower of all, your heart. {{NAME}} lay back in the soft grass and felt completely happy. He closed his eyes slowly. He wondered what song the fairies might teach him tomorrow.
